title: Construct Validity of Coding Benchmarks for LLM-based Agentic Coding Tools
title_zh: 面向LLM智能体编码工具的编码基准的构念效度

paragraphs.en: 分析九个智能体编码基准的构念效度，发现指标覆盖窄、混淆因素各异且缺乏标准化，并提出改进建议。 Software developers increasingly adopt LLM-based agentic coding tools to assist them with development tasks. To provide developers with up-to-date information on these tools' effectiveness, prior work introduced benchmarks that enable comparisons across tools. Despite the widespread adoption of such benchmarks, however, recent work has shown that they suffer from issues threatening their validity. Aims. In this work, we aim to complement prior work by analyzing the construct validity of agentic coding benchmarks. Methodology. We analyze nine benchmarks commonly used to evaluate the effectiveness of agentic coding tools. We identify the constructs that the benchmarks claim to measure, the metrics used to operationalize them, and potential confounders that interfere with the measurement. Results. Our findings show that benchmarks commonly operationalize broad concepts such as coding capability with only a small set of metrics. The reported attributes that might confound the measurements vary between benchmarks, indicating a lack of standardization. Conclusions. We conclude with recommendations to strengthen construct validity in agentic coding benchmarks and encourage further empirical work to better understand the effectiveness of agentic coding tools.
paragraphs.zh: 分析九个智能体编码基准的构念效度，发现指标覆盖窄、混淆因素各异且缺乏标准化，并提出改进建议。软件开发者越来越多地采用基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体编码工具来辅助他们完成开发任务。 为了向开发者提供关于这些工具有效性的最新信息，先前的工作引入了可以对各工具进行比较的基准。 然而，尽管此类基准被广泛采用，最近的研究表明它们存在威胁其效度的问题。研究目的。 在本工作中，我们旨在通过分析智能体编码基准的构念效度来补充先前的工作。研究方法。 我们分析了常用于评估智能体编码工具有效性的九个基准。 我们识别出这些基准声称要测量的构念、用于操作化这些构念的指标，以及干扰测量的潜在混淆因素。研究结果。 我们的发现表明，这些基准通常仅用一小组指标来操作化诸如编码能力之类的宽泛概念。 各基准所报告的可能混淆测量的属性各不相同，表明缺乏标准化。结论。 我们最后提出了增强智能体编码基准构念效度的建议，并鼓励进一步开展实证工作，以更好地理解智能体编码工具的有效性。
